items.title: 9.1 Mehfooz aur zimmedarana digital amal (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of safe and responsible digital practices (PDF 123-125).

blocks.text: Mehfooz aur zimmedarana digital amal ka matlab technology ko samajhdari se use karna aur online zaati maloomat ki hifazat hai: mazboot passwords, taaza software aur ghair-mehfooz websites se parhez (Fig 9.2). Yeh aadatein data ke zaya, hacking aur shanakht ki chori se bachati hain, taake users be-wajah khatre ke baghair technology se faida uthayein aur mehfooz, qabil-e-bharosa digital mahol banne mein madad dein.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: 12 characters ka mazboot password torne mein computer ko lakhon saal lag sakte hain, lekin kamzor password seconds mein toot sakta hai.
Online hifazat

Online hifazat ka matlab Internet par apni aur apni maloomat ki hifazat hai: share karne, click karne aur data rakhne mein ehtiyat. Online amal digital nishan (footprints) chhorte hain jinhein track kiya ja sakta hai, is liye chaukanna rehna dhoke, viruses aur doosre khatron se bachata aur zaati aur school ka data mehfooz rakhta hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Khatron aur un se bachao ki samajh cybercrime ka imkaan kam karti hai.
Mazboot passwords

Mazboot password chhote bare huroof, numbers aur symbols milata aur andaza lagana mushkil hota hai. Har account ka alag password rakhein, naam ya salgirah jaisi zaati tafseel se bachein, leak hone ka shak ho to badlein, aur kabhi share na karein. Mazboot password aap ki files aur accounts ka pehla difa hai.

blocks.title: Baqaida password badalne par
blocks.text: Kitab baqaida passwords badalne ka mashwara deti hai. Aaj ki security rehnumai lambe, munfarid passwords pasand karti hai jo chori ke shak par badle jayein, two-factor authentication ke saath, kyunke zabardasti baar baar badalne se aksar kamzor passwords bante hain.
Khatarnak downloads aur ghair-mehfooz browsing

Na-maloom websites ki files ya programs mein viruses ya spyware chhupe ho sakte hain jo computer ko nuqsan pohanchate ya ijazat ke baghair data jama karte hain. Jaali websites par jana ya na-maloom links click karna dhoke ya shanakht ki chori tak le ja sakta hai. Download se pehle zariya jaanchein aur izafi hifazat ke liye antivirus tools use karein.
Software ki dekh-bhaal aur updates

Software ki dekh-bhaal ka matlab programs ko baqaida update kar ke achhi halat mein rakhna hai. Updates ghaltiyan theek, karkardagi behtar aur woh security khala band karti hain jin se hackers faida utha sakte hain. Purana software aasan nishana hai: purane versions mein maloom security soorakh, compatibility ke masail aur malware aur data breach ka zyada khatra hota hai, is liye baqaida updates systems ko mehfooz aur qabil-e-aitbaar rakhti hain.

blocks.title: Class activity
blocks.text: Updated aur purane software ki khusoosiyat ka muwazna karein, aur guftagu karein ke purane versions par hamla kaise ho sakta hai.
Privacy aur security settings

Privacy aur security settings, jo zyada tar apps aur websites mein hoti hain, users ko control deti hain ke un ki zaati maloomat, jaise location, contacts aur browsing history, kaise use aur share ho. Maslan Instagram par user account private kar sakta hai taake sirf manzoor shuda followers posts dekhein, location sharing band aur two-factor authentication on kar sakta hai. WhatsApp par users chun sakte hain ke profile photo kaun dekhe (sab, sirf contacts ya koi nahi) aur read receipts (neele tick) band kar sakte hain. Settings baqaida dekhni chahiye, kyunke platforms apni khusoosiyat aur qawaid badalte rehte hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Settings baqaida dekhna aap ko mehfooz rakhta hai jab platforms apni khusoosiyat update karte hain.
Privacy policies parhna

Privacy policy batati hai ke website ya app aap ka data kaise jama, mehfooz, use aur share karti hai. Account banane ya shartein qabool karne se pehle ise parhein: social platform par sign up karte waqt policy batati hai ke kya jama ho sakta hai (naam, email, location, browsing activity, app ka istemal) aur kya yeh advertisers ya teesre fareeq ke saath share hota hai. Is se aap tay kar sakte hain ke data share karein ya nahi.
Mehfooz online ishtirak

Online ishtirak logon ko digital tools se kaheen se bhi mil kar kaam karne deta hai, is liye files share karte waqt mehfooz platforms aur hifazati qawaid apnayein. Google Workspace aur Microsoft Teams jaise mehfooz platforms encrypted rabta aur rasai ke control use karte hain. Google Docs mein group project ke liye file sirf bharosemand hum-jamaaton ke saath mehdood rasai se share karein, aur jinhein sirf parhna ho unhein 'Edit' ke bajaye 'View only' dein; Google Meet par online classes sirf ijazat yafta shurakaa ko dakhil kar sakti hain.
Digital adaab

Digital adaab ka matlab online shaistagi, izzat aur wazahat se baat karna hai: munasib zaban, doosron ki raye ka ehtram, zaati maloomat share na karna aur tools ka ghalat istemal na karna. Class ke group chat mein sanjeeda guftagu ke dauran spam, be-talluq memes ya mazaq se bachein, taake group mufeed aur parhai par markooz rahe.

blocks.alt: Chhe mehfooz aadaton ki checklist, har aik par tick: mazboot, munfarid passwords (12 ya zyada characters; huroof, numbers, symbols; har account ka alag); software taaza rakhein; sirf bharosemand zaraye se download; privacy settings jaanchein; two-factor authentication on; share ya click se pehle sochein. Saath ka dabba banawati kamzor password (ali2008: naam aur paidaish ka saal, chhota) ka mazboot (Kite!Rain7-Chai*Lake: lamba, mila jula, kuch zaati nahi) se muwazna.
blocks.caption: Mehfooz digital aadatein (Fig 9.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Misali passwords sikhane ke liye banawati hain; kaheen bhi chhapa password, yahan bhi, kabhi use nahi karna chahiye.

blocks.prompt: Aap ka cousin email, Facebook aur shopping app ke liye aik hi chhota password, apna naam aur paidaish ka saal, use karta hai. Use teen mashware dein.
blocks.explanation: Lamba password (12 ya zyada characters) jis mein huroof, numbers aur symbols hon aur kuch zaati na ho; har account ka alag password, shayad password manager ke saath; aur two-factor authentication on karein, taake sirf chori ka password account na khol sake.
